categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen VMAX New Energy (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy vehicle sector, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of new energy vehicle power domain products. Key product lines include onboard power supplies such as onboard chargers, DC/DC converters, integrated power supply products, electric drive systems including motor controllers and integrated drive assemblies, electric vehicle communication controllers (EVCC), and liquid-cooled charging pile modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced power electronics technologies including magnetic integration control decoupling, output port circuit integration control, single-phase and three-phase charging compatibility, V2X inverter safety control, reverse pre-charging, high-efficiency cooling structural design, multi-in-one power domain controller technology, dual motor controller technology, third-generation semiconductor material applications, and 800V high-voltage platform development. Production emphasizes automation, intelligent manufacturing, and digital factory initiatives, including fully automated assembly lines and smart warehouses with AI-enabled quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: VMAX serves major domestic and international new energy vehicle manufacturers, including leading Chinese new car makers such as XPeng, Li Auto, Leapmotor, Lantu, and established automakers like Changan, Geely, Chery, SAIC, Great Wall, Dongfeng Nissan, and joint ventures such as SAIC Audi. International customers include Stellantis Group, Renault, Aston Martin, and Ferrari. The company’s products are integrated into various new energy vehicle models and exported globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen and Wuhu, and has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Japan, France, Singapore, and ongoing construction of a production base in Thailand to serve Southeast Asian markets. It maintains a global supply chain network aligned with international automotive markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: VMAX operates as a midstream supplier specializing in core components for new energy vehicles, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of power electronics and electric drive systems that are critical to vehicle electrification. It acts as a Tier 1 supplier providing customized solutions directly to OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous independent R&D and technological innovation, investing heavily in developing integrated, high-voltage, multifunctional power electronics and electric drive systems. It focuses on product miniaturization, lightweight design, cost reduction, and enhanced reliability. Strategic R&D projects include next-generation integrated chargers, electric drive control systems, wireless charging, and liquid-cooled ultra-fast charging modules. Globalization and digital factory transformation are also key strategic pillars.
categories.revenue_model: VMAX generates revenue primarily through direct sales of its new energy vehicle power domain products to OEM customers under long-term supply agreements. The company employs a direct sales model with order-based production, including consignment and non-consignment settlement methods. It also earns income from technical services related to product development and customization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: VMAX holds a leading position in the Chinese onboard charger market, ranking second with a 19% market share and first in third-party supply with a 29.41% share. It competes with other domestic and international automotive parts suppliers, including traditional fuel vehicle parts manufacturers transitioning to new energy sectors and power electronics firms. Its early entry into integrated power supply products and global OEM partnerships strengthen its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, VMAX reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.37 billion, a 15.39% year-over-year increase, driven by growth in integrated onboard power supplies and rapid expansion of electric drive system sales (418.39% growth). Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 400 million, down 20.34% year-over-year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.69 billion, up 6.36%. R&D investment increased by 43.24% to RMB 385 million, representing 6.05% of revenue. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues expanding production capacity and global market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VMAX emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and integrated product platforms that deliver high power density, reduced size and weight, cost efficiency, and multifunctionality such as V2X capabilities. Its automated and intelligent manufacturing processes ensure high quality and scalability. The company’s global OEM certifications and awards, including Stellantis’ global supplier quality awards, underscore its product reliability and brand recognition internationally.
